title: Ophthalmic Essentials: Maculopathies, Retinal Detachment & Clinical Pearls
summary: This vibrant poster provides an in-depth look at critical ophthalmic conditions, covering the diverse etiologies of Bull's Eye Maculopathy, genetic insights into Stargardt Disease and Best Vitelliform Macular Dystrophy, and the systemic complexities of Gyrate Atrophy and Stickler Syndrome. It also offers a crucial differential diagnosis for Cherry Red Spot and a detailed comparison of Retinal Detachment vs. Retinoschisis, alongside practical management considerations.

sections.title: Stargardt Disease: A Deep Dive into ABCA4 Maculopathy
sections.content:
• AR ( most common) STG1
• ABCA4 gene on chromosome 1p

sections.title: Stargardt Disease: Key Signs
content: macula : mottling , ﬁne ﬂecks progress to oval snail slime or beaten bronze appearance , atrophy ( bulls eye conﬁguration) , MNV
numerous yellow white round oval pisciform ﬁsh shaped lesions at the level of RPE conﬁned to posterior pole or extend to mid periphery

sections.title: Stargardt Disease: Investigations – A Systematic Approach
content: Visual ﬁeld: Microperimetry Central loss Document progression

FA: Dark chroid dt masking of background choroidal ﬂuorescence by lipofuscin accumulation in RPE Macula : mixed hyper and hypo ﬂuorescence Fresh ﬂecks : early hypoﬂuorescence dt blockage , hyperﬂuorescence dt stainning Old ﬂecks : RPE window defect
ICGA: Hypoﬂorescence spots numerous than seen clinically
late FAF: Hyperautoﬂourescence ﬂecks, macular hypoautoﬂuorescence
ERG: Photopic is normal to subnormal , scotooic may be
EOG: Sub normal especially in advanced casses normal

sections.title: Stargardt Disease: Management & Future Directions
content: Attach the patient to social services
Protection from high energy light exposure
Avoid vit a supplementation as it may accelerate lipofuscinoid accumulation
Clinical trials: gene therapy , stem cell therapy , Pharma therapy, metformin taken by mouth

sections.title: Best Vitelliform Macular Dystrophy: The "Egg Yolk" Lesion
sections.content:
• Gene :bestrophin gene best1gene on chromosome 11q13
• Inheritance : AD with variable penetrance and expressivity

sections.title: Best Vitelliform Macular Dystrophy: Diagnostic Investigations
content: FAF: Yellowish material intensely hyperautoﬂuorescent later atrophic stages hypoautoﬂuorescent area supervene
FA: Corresponding hypoﬂuorescence due to masking

EOG: Severly subnormal during all stages arden index <1.5 and is also abnormal in carriers with abnormal fundi

sections.title: Gyrate Atrophy: A Metabolic Retinopathy
sections.content:
• AR
• Mutation in OAT gene chromosome 10q
• Oat gene encode for ornithine aminotransferase
• Deﬁciency of enzyme —> elevated ornithine levels in plasma, urine ,csf,aqueous humour
• Poor visual prognosis

sections.title: Gyrate Atrophy: Clinical Presentation
content: Symptoms: myopia, nyctalopia, worsening of vision
Signs: mid peripheral depigmented spots + diffuse pigmentary mottling
Sharply demarcated circular or oval areas of chorioretinal atrophy develop these may be associated with glistening crystals at the posterior pole
Coalescence of atrophic areas and gradual peripheral and central spread

sections.title: Gyrate Atrophy: Diagnostic Workup
content: FA: sharp demarcation between areas of choroidal atrophy and normal choriocapillaris
ERG: subnormal in early disease and later extinguished

sections.title: Gyrate Atrophy: Therapeutic Strategies
content: Arginine restricted diet to decrease ornithine levels
Vit B6 supplementation to reduce plasma ornithine

sections.title: Stickler Syndrome Type 1: Ocular Features
content: circumferential equatorial membranes that extend a short way into vitreous cavity
radial lattice degeneration with rpe hyperplasia
multiple ,gaint tears that involve both eyes
presenile cataract peripheral cortical wedge shaped , ﬂeck or lamellar opacities
glaucoma associated with congenital angle anomaly

sections.title: Stickler Syndrome Type 1: Systemic Features
content: deafness (SNHL, or caused by recurrent otitis media)

sections.title: Stickler Syndrome: Kinest Dysplasia (Related)
sections.content: Kinest dysplasia: high myopia, ectopia lentis, vitreous degeneration,retinal detachment, short stature , round face, arthropathy
